LESSON: RIGHTS OF NEIGHBOURS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.2: Rights of Neighbours

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Rights of Neighbours. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Rights of Neighbours
2. Practise Rights of Neighbours at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Rights of Neighbours

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Rights of Neighbours
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Rights of Neighbours. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Rights of Neighbours at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Rights of Neighbours at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Rights of Neighbours
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Rights of Neighbours. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Rights of Neighbours using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Rights of Neighbours in the examples.
2. Explain Rights of Neighbours to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Rights of Neighbours.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Rights of Neighbours using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Rights of Neighbours important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Rights of Neighbours
2. Practise Rights of Neighbours at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Rights of Neighbours

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
